تستشعرون (form X)
# تَسْتَشْعِرُونَ (tastašʕirūna) /tas.taʃ.ʕi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَشْعَرَ (istašʕara)
# تُسْتَشْعَرُونَ (tustašʕarūna) /tus.taʃ.ʕa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَشْعَرَ (istašʕara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
